sources.description: National Bank of Poland - daily FX mid rates (USD/PLN, EUR/PLN).
sources.notes: Keyless. Range endpoint limited to ~93 days per request; backfill in windows.

sources.description: One-off NBP Table A backfill (2026-04-20..2026-07-17) so the marts have a real time series.
sources.notes: Range endpoint returns one document per business day. Set enabled=false once it has run; kept as a record of the backfill.

sources.description: EIA - WTI crude oil spot price, Cushing OK (series RWTC), daily, USD per barrel.
sources.notes: First api_key source. The key is NOT here - only secret_name, resolved from Key Vault at runtime by ADF's managed identity and appended as &api_key=.

sources.description: EIA - Brent crude oil spot price, Europe (series RBRTE), daily, USD per barrel.
sources.notes: Same EIA endpoint and key as WTI, different series (RBRTE). Both flow into the generic EIA_PETROLEUM_SPOT_RAW bronze table and stg_eia__petroleum_spot.

sources.description: Open-Meteo - daily weather for Warsaw (temp max/min, precipitation). Demand-signals domain.
sources.notes: Keyless. Archive API returns parallel arrays under 'daily' (time[i] matches temperature_2m_max[i]); staging zips them by index. Archive has a ~5-day lag. end_date={ingest_date} is replaced with today's date by ADF at runtime, so the window advances automatically.

sources.description: ECB - euro short-term rate (STR), daily, percent. Macro rates domain.
sources.notes: Keyless. FIRST CSV source (SDMX wide CSV, header row, quoted fields). Snowflake loads it with a CSV file format (ff_csv), selecting columns by position. Others so far are JSON. endPeriod={ingest_date} is replaced with today's date by ADF at runtime, so the window advances automatically.

sources.description: Eurostat - civil engineering production index (roads/infrastructure), Poland, monthly, 2021=100. Demand-signals domain.
sources.notes: Keyless. JSON-stat: value is a flat {index:value} map; non-time dims are size 1 so the flat index equals the time index. Staging flattens dimension.time.category.index and looks up value[index]. MONTHLY (introduces mixed frequencies vs the daily sources).

sources.description: GUS BDL - length of expressways and motorways in Poland (variable 453823), annual, km. Roads / demand-signals domain.
sources.notes: Keyless (GUS BDL works without a key at low rates). JSON: results[] per area, each with values[] per year. ANNUAL - adds a third frequency (daily/monthly/annual) for the reconciliation work.
